tx:
In Pirate's Treasure, filling a crate with bananas for Luthas is necessary so that the player can smuggle a bottle of Karamjan rum off Karamja to Port Sarim.
Players can make money from bananas on Musa Point by talking to Luthas and then filling a crate with 10 bananas, obtaining 30 coins. However, as 10 bananas are worth on the Grand Exchange, it is much better to sell them there.
Bananas are needed to bait baby monkeys, which requires level 27 Hunter and level 95 Summoning. Bananas are also necessary to feed the pet monkey when it becomes an adult.
A single banana is required to cast the standard spellbook Ape Atoll Teleport with 64 Magic in addition to its cost in runes.
A banana is sliced into sliced banana and added to Karamjan rum to make Karamjan rum (sliced banana), which is used in the Tai Bwo Wannai Trio. A whole banana can also be added to Karamjan rum to make Karamjan rum (banana), but this is a waste of both items as the item has no use.
During Monkey Madness, when the player has the monkey rescued from the Ardougne Zoo, the player can use bananas on the monkey to "feed" him.
Additionally, you can use the bananas for Clue's in the Monkey Drool, which is an achievement that requires the player to receive the sealed clue scroll (medium) from the monkey in the backpack during or after the Monkey Madness quest, after feeding it a number of bananas. The drop rate is 1 in 256. When this happens, a message appears in the player's chatbox saying "The monkey chews on the banana and spits out a clue!".
If used on one of the monkeys next to the magic carpet stations while wearing a monkeyspeak amulet, the monkey will take the banana, insult you and ask for more bananas.
sc: It can also be picked from banana trees found at Musa Point and on Ape Atoll.
It is one of the items Ava asks the player to obtain in order to make an arrow making contraption - either Ava's attractor or Ava's accumulator depending on the players Ranged level.
Bathus ore is tier 1 ore that can be obtained by picking up the broken longsword lying on the ground during the Three's Company Fremennik Saga.
One bathus ore must be obtained for full completion.
The beginner's tackle box is the entry-level tackle box purchased as a reward from Fish Flingers, a Distraction and Diversion.
Black crossbows are a possible reward from easy Treasure Trails.
Unlike most crossbows, they cannot be made using the Fletching skill.
The black pearl is one of two selectable rewards for defeating Agoroth that can be claimed from the dead man's chest in the Ashdale Caves.
After the quest, players may select coins instead of black pearls as a reward for defeating Agoroth.
The black Santa hat was obtainable during the 15 Days of Christmas mini-event, starting on 20 December 2013, ending on 3 January 2014.
The hat could be obtained by pulling a festive cracker, with a drop chance of 1 in 2,000.
The blue cape is a reward from Nomad's Requiem quest.
Multiple capes can be obtained by dropping the capes a player already owns before buying a new one.
The blue circle is an item used in The Prisoner of Glouphrie created by using a minute crystal seed on the singing bowl.
